 Serie A - Game Week 11 Nov 7, 2026 - 09:00 Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino DAZN will broadcast Torino-Lecce live. Subscription and viewing options are listed below.
 At the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino, Torino host Lecce in the 11th round of Serie A 2026/27. Both sides come into the fixture after disappointing results in the previous round.
 Ignazio Abate's Torino have lost their last two league matches, first going down 3-1 at home to Como, then losing 2-0 away to Frosinone. Only a few weeks ago, they had put together three consecutive wins.
 For Eusebio Di Francesco's Lecce, the slump runs deeper. They have lost four of their last five Serie A matches, including a heavy 5-1 defeat at Frosinone and a 2-1 loss to Genoa in the previous round.
 Injuries have left Abate without six players, while Di Francesco has five unavailable, limiting his options particularly in attack and midfield.
 With Torino tenth and Lecce 14th, three points separate the sides. The result matters to both in the battle to avoid relegation and the race for European places.

 Torino are without Rolando Mandragora, Franco Israel, Niccolò Fortini, Ricardo Rodriguez, Rafik Belghali and Alessio Cacciamani through injury. Abate is expected to start Lucas Perri in goal, with Ardian Ismajli, Saul Coco and Pietro Comuzzo in defence. Nathan Patterson, Gvidas Gineitis, Daniel Bragança and Zakaria Aboukhlal are expected in midfield, with Nikola Vlasic behind the Adams-Simeone partnership.
 Without Lassana Coulibaly, Willem Geubbels, Santiago Pierotti, Medon Berisha and Joel Monteiro through injury, Lecce have no suspended players. Di Francesco is expected to start Wladimiro Falcone in goal, with Corrie Ndaba, Tiago Gabriel, Jamil Siebert and Antonino Gallo in defence. Youssef Maleh, Oumar Ngom and Olaf Gorter are expected in midfield, with Danilo Veiga, Nikola Stulic and Konan N'Dri forming the front three.

Their two defeats came in succession: a 3-1 home loss to Como followed by a 2-0 loss at Frosinone. Before that run, Abate's side beat Monza 3-2 and won 3-0 at Parma, showing a solidity they have lacked in recent weeks.
 In their last five Serie A matches, Lecce have won once and lost four times, scoring five goals and conceding twelve. They come into this game after a 2-1 defeat to Genoa, preceded by a heavy 5-1 loss at Frosinone and a 2-0 defeat to Juventus. Their emphatic 3-0 win over Udinese remains the only bright spot in that spell. Di Francesco's side have gone four consecutive matches without a win.
